event.felix_heart2.0.text: Mornin'. Take the rod. Both hands. There's one down there with your name on it, [player].
event.felix_heart2.0.why: specific promise instead of instruction; sets up the tuna

event.felix_heart2.2.text: Keep it. You earned it. This rock, six most days. ...I'm not asking. I'm saying where the rock is.
event.felix_heart2.2.why: the want (a partner) denied out loud; sharper subtext

event.felix_heart5.0.text: Every fisher carries a lucky charm. Mine's been through forty years of dawns and one pocket.
event.felix_heart5.0.why: the pocket makes the charm an object, not a speech

event.past_the_point.0.text: There you are. The boat I promised. She floats. I checked twice. The bailing tin is the elegant part.
event.past_the_point.0.why: pays off the heart5 promise in so many words; shorter beats

event.past_the_point.4.text: Dawn's better with two. Three makes it an expedition. ...One place off the list. For the rest, I'll want a bigger boat.
event.past_the_point.4.why: funniest word last; points at the rest of Elara's list

dlg.story.whistler.felix.r0.text: Hello. Yes. Hello back. ...The tune and I were braced for worse.
dlg.story.whistler.felix.r0.why: his fear of the quiet dawn under the joke, not stiff phrasing

event.felix_heart8.intro.text: Quiet, now. All week I've had a feeling. It's on the line this minute. Take the net. Don't breathe.
event.felix_heart8.intro.why: cleaner opening; drops the place-name so Beach map and pond lore both survive

event.felix_birthday.intro.text: My birthday. Tilda outlawed fishing till noon. She brought a pie. I brought a story. It's about a fish.
event.felix_birthday.intro.why: 'till noon' reconciles the shipped line where he plans to fish his birthday

event.felix_courtship.intro.text: Mornin'. No. Not just mornin'. I've held a line through a gale and this is harder. Would you court me? Slowly, like the tide.
event.felix_courtship.intro.why: his own greeting fails him; the nerves are in the false start

event.felix_courtship2.intro.text: Second cast. Same bait, same hope. Would you court me? Still slowly.
event.felix_courtship2.intro.why: shorter; 'same hope' says what a year of patience cost

event.overheard_tilda_felix_2.l1.text: Tilda. Remember the winter the pond froze, and I went out to test it?
event.overheard_tilda_felix_2.l1.why: 'test it' lets Tilda's 'you fell in' land as the correction

event.overheard_felix_elara_1.l3.text: ...It does look warm. Hand it over. Strictly for the fish.
event.overheard_felix_elara_1.l3.why: 'for science' wasn't my mouth; the excuse is now a fisher's

adds.text: You should've seen the other one. There's always another one. That's what gets a fisher up before the sun.
adds.why: plants the catchphrase at first meeting so every later telling pays off

threads.felix_heart2: The rock at six most days, and whether Felix was asking for company without asking.
threads.felix_heart5: The boat that leaks politely: when will he finally show it?
threads.past_the_point: The bigger boat Felix wants for the rest of Elara's list.
threads.story_whistler_felix: Same lane, same hour tomorrow, and whether the player will 'happen to be passing'.
threads.story_pumpkin_felix: The one story Felix refuses to tell, because beside the pumpkin his biggest carp looked like bait.
threads.felix_heart8: The fish, or the story of it, will keep growing, and there's a dawn appointment for next year.
threads.felix_birthday: Dawn tomorrow off the good rock, and a story now one hand longer.
threads.felix_courtship: Half the rock stays saved, whatever the answer was.
threads.felix_courtship2: The thermos, and for once, two cups.
threads.felix_partners: The shell on the shelf that still says the player's name. Or 'hello'.

notes: felix_heart8: the card puts the scene on the Beach map but the bible and the old intro say the pond. I removed the place-name from the intro so the words fit either; the Director should settle the map.
felix_heart2: the beat keys play in the order .0 .1 .3 .2. Kept as-is per mechanics, but worth renumbering before another pass trips on it.
felix_birthday: the shipped line has me planning to fish on my birthday; Tilda's ban now runs 'till noon' so both stay true.
overheard_tilda_felix_2: my opener is now 'I went out to test it'; Tilda's existing reply lands harder and needs no change from her.
